question: Should maintainers ask this PR to be ported and narrowed, or treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 as the canonical current-file fix for the shared read-image media gap?
rationale: The underlying bug remains valid, but this branch is stale to removed files and overlaps a newer current-file PR that is not yet proof-positive, so cleanup cannot safely close or merge either path without maintainer choice.

options.title: Use the current-file shared PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 as the canonical landing path, require its proof and lint gaps to be resolved, and have it explicitly cover this Feishu report.

options.title: Ask this PR to port forward
options.body: Keep this PR as the reporter-owned path, but require a rebase onto current `embedded-agent-subscribe.*` files plus the read-only trust narrowing before further review.

options.title: Pause both until proof exists
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and wait for maintainer or contributor real behavior proof before selecting a landing branch.

recommendation.title: Use the current-file shared PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 as the canonical landing path, require its proof and lint gaps to be resolved, and have it explicitly cover this Feishu report.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent current-file agent media history and refactor ownership make this the best available routing owner for choosing the landing path.
